text:
```yaml
name: Release Py

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - "py/**"

jobs:
  release-py:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up uv
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
          version: "0.5.6"

      - name: Run release script
        run: |
          chmod +x py/common/release.sh
          ./py/common/release.sh
```
